newsitem.title: USA: SEC halts trade in OmniGene Diagnostics.
newsitem.headline: SEC halts trade in OmniGene Diagnostics.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Commission said Wednesday it suspended trading in OmniGene Diagnostics Inc because of questions raised about the accuracy and adequacy of its information.
The suspension became effective at 0930 EST/1430 GMT on Nov 20 and will last through December 4, the commission said in a statement.

The temporary suspension arose from the company's alleged ownership and other rights as to certain patents and trademarks, past and projected sales, operations and facilities, and the number of freely traded shares of stock.
On Oct 28, the West Palm Beach, Fla., company set a four-for-one stock split effective November 15. Its outstanding shares will rise to six million common from 1.5 million common.
OmniGene produces a DNA probe-based test for the detection of periodontal disease.
